classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding sides in nested similar triangles and distinguish whole sides from their component segments.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in each of these triangles.

spec.description: Triangle with an internal horizontal segment parallel to the base; retain the redundant lower-right 5 cm given.
spec.mathematics: Upper and lower left segments are 9 cm and 3 cm. Internal parallel segment is 6 cm; base is x. Lower right segment is 5 cm. Matching single parallel marks.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; supplied answer excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The triangles are similar because the marked sides are parallel. The whole left side is $9+3=12\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{6}&=\frac{12}{9}\\x&=6\times\frac{12}{9}\\x&=8\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Smaller triangle lies on the right; its left side is parallel to the outer left side.
spec.mathematics: Outer left side is 9 cm. Base segments are 9 cm on the left and 6 cm on the right. Internal parallel side is x. Matching single parallel marks.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; supplied answer excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The triangles are similar because the marked sides are parallel. The whole base is $9+6=15\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{9}&=\frac{6}{15}\\x&=9\times\frac{6}{15}\\x&=3.6\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Smaller triangle lies on the right; preserve the distinct internal-side and base-segment 6 cm labels.
spec.mathematics: Outer left side is 15 cm. Internal parallel side is 6 cm. Base segments are x on the left and 6 cm on the right. Matching single parallel marks.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; supplied answer excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The triangles are similar because the marked sides are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x+6}{6}&=\frac{15}{6}\\x+6&=6\times\frac{15}{6}\\x+6&=15\\x&=9\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Internal horizontal segment is parallel to the base; the unknown is the upper left segment, not the whole side.
spec.mathematics: Upper left segment is x, lower left segment is 6 cm. Internal parallel segment is 6 cm and base is 9 cm. Matching single parallel marks.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; supplied answer excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The triangles are similar because the marked sides are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{x+6}&=\frac{6}{9}\\x&=\frac{6}{9}(x+6)\\9x&=6x+36\\3x&=36\\x&=12\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
